digest.component_or_area: S3 coordinator for non-create plan execution and endpoint-failure fuse
propositions: Non-create plans (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict handling) must execute as atomic postconditions in dependency order, preserving earlier successes and re-observing only remaining drift on partial failure within a single shared budget.

Failure scope isolation must distinguish ticket-local and permanent failures (affecting only that ticket), authoritative broad scopes (affecting only their declared scope), and independent tickets/endpoints (continuing unaffected).

Endpoint-failure fuse opens after three consecutive eligible exhausted outcomes across at least two tickets; provider-failure fuse additionally requires outcomes spanning two or more distinct endpoints of the same provider; a matching success resets consecutive state.

Eligible exhausted outcomes are keyed only on budget-exhaustion provenance (plan_next_retry returning action=exhausted or action=defer at cap), excluding physical attempts, recovered warnings, permanent failures, ticket-local 404s, opaque commit_unknown, and adapter transients not produced by shared budget exhaustion.

Remaining matching work defers explicitly with reason/scope/retry_not_before when a fuse opens, while independent scopes continue; applied, failed, deferred, skipped, and recovered tallies plus exit status must be exact.
Historical replay and verified-fake batches must demonstrate zero premature termination of observed successful or partially successful work and correct wire-order, call-count, and tally semantics.
